The Trapper.territorial: Lock down a 3-gen area early. Set traps on key loops and tall grass. Play defensive.
The Trapper.basement: Get an early down near the basement or use Agitation to carry them. Trap the entrances heavily.

The Wraith.hit-and-run: Uncloak, get a quick hit, and cloak again to drop chase. Keep applying map-wide pressure until everyone is injured.

The Hillbilly.lethal-chase: Use your sprint to cross the map quickly. Rely on Bamboozle to force survivors into the open.

The Nurse.aura-slugging: Use Lethal Pursuer to start your first chase instantly. Blink to auras revealed by Infectious Fright.

The Shape.tombstone: Play passively early on. Stalk as much as possible until you pop Tier 3, then surprise them with instant kills.
The Shape.scratched-mirror: With 0 terror radius, see survivor auras through walls and ambush them around corners. Avoid standard loops.

The Hag.territorial: Set up a triangle of 3 generators early. Place your traps tightly around loops and choke points in that area.

The Doctor.impossible-skillcheck: Shock survivors constantly to keep them in Madness Tier 2 or 3. Their skill checks will be very difficult.

The Huntress.aura-sniper: Aura reading is your bread and butter. Look for distant targets and practice long-range hatchet throws.

The Cannibal.basement-defense: Get an early basement hook. If survivors come for a save, rev your chainsaw at the stairs.

The Nightmare.endgame: Play a normal match, but prepare for the exit gates. Blood Warden and No Way Out give you massive snowball potential.

The Pig.headtrap-stall: Sneak up on survivors to secure an early down. Apply a Reverse Bear Trap immediately, forcing them to search boxes.

The Clown.chase-denial: Throw a pink bottle at loops to slow them down, and use your yellow bottle for a speed boost.

The Spirit.hit-and-run: Phase walk toward generators to get quick first hits. Listen closely since they cannot hear you approaching.

The Legion.mend-simulator: Use Feral Frenzy to injure multiple survivors quickly. Apply deep wounds to everyone to waste their time.

The Plague.anti-heal: Vomit on generators, pallets, and survivors. Force them to stay broken. Grab Corrupt Purge if they dare cleanse.

The Ghost Face.stealth-stalk: Lean around corners to stalk survivors faster. 99% their stalk meter, then expose and instadown them out of nowhere.

The Demogorgon.portal-pressure: Place portals near high-traffic generators. Use shred to break pallets instantly or catch survivors locked in vault animations.

The Oni.slug-snowball: Hit survivors early to gather blood. Unleash Blood Fury to instadown multiple targets across the map.

The Deathslinger.ranged-zoning: Shoot survivors over short loops and pull them in for a hit. Reload quickly and keep punishing greed.

The Executioner.cages-torment: Force survivors onto your Torment trails at loops so you can send them to Cages of Atonement.

The Blight.lethal-rush: Bounce off geometry to catch up to survivors incredibly fast. Predict their movement and strike.

The Twins.slug-camp: Use Victor to scout and down injured survivors, leaving Charlotte to defend hooks and important generators.

The Trickster.chase-denial: Throw knives to slowly build up Laceration on survivors until they take a health state of damage.

The Nemesis.rapid-fire: Lacerate survivors over low loops with your knives. Keep distance to maximize your punishment over pallets and windows.

The Cenobite.anti-loop: Use your chains to slow survivors down at loops. Protect the puzzle box to initiate Chain Hunts continuously.

The Artist.crow-sniper: Shoot birds directly at generators to check for survivors, or place them at loops to deny pathing.

The Onryo.tape-condemn: Teleport constantly to build Condemned on survivors, forcing them to turn off TVs instead of doing generators.

The Dredge.nightfall-ambush: Stay inside lockers near high-activity areas. Utilize Nightfall to strip survivors of their visibility while chasing.

The Mastermind.zombie-pressure: Whip survivors over pallets with your tentacle. Use the zombies to patrol areas passively while you chase.

The Knight.jailer-patrol: Send out your guards to check generators or break pallets for you. Pincer survivors between you and your guards.

The Skull Merchant.drone-defense: Place drones on important generators and choke points. Chase survivors into your active drone zones to expose them.

The Singularity.slipstream-chase: Shoot your pods at high vantage points. Mark survivors with slipstream to teleport instantly behind them in chases.

The Xenomorph.tunnel-ambush: Use your tunnels to cross the map quickly. Emerge near generators and use your tail strike over loops to hit survivors.

The Good Guy.scamper-chase: Use Hidey-Ho mode to rapidly close the distance. Scamper under pallets and deliver a massive slicing attack.

The Unknown.hallucination-snipe: Launch UVX projectiles at the floor/walls next to survivors. Use your hallucinations to teleport and maintain map presence.

The Dark Lord.default: Focus on using your unique power to control loops and apply map pressure.
